source.label: rec.games.trading-cards.magic.misc, 'East Coast Validation (Type I Natn'l Champ)', Rudy Edward, 16 Sep 1996

notes.text: Date not verified. Posts dated Monday 16 Sep 1996 describe 'the Type 1 Nationals in Toledo this weekend'; the day of the final is not given, and AndCon '96's dates were not found in any archived Andon page. 15 Sep (the Sunday) is a placeholder.
Name: Usenet posters call it the 'Type I Natn'l Championship' / 'Type 1 Nationals'. No Andon or Wizards announcement for 1996 was found, so the official billing is not verified.

Eric Taylor, who lost to Adams in the final 16, reports 'only about 60 people' and that the cut was meant to be a final 8 but was extended to 16. The finalist is not named (Taylor says only that Adams's final opponent played creatures such as the insect and Erhnam).
Christian Pantages names 'Yan Ebyam, a top eight finisher'; that name is likely a handle ('Maybe Nay' backwards) and the finish is not given, so he is not listed.

From Chesterfield, VA. No list survives; Taylor describes blue control with Autumn Willow, Merchant Scroll, Amnesia, Demonic Tutor, Force of Will, Counterspell, Mana Drain, two main-deck Red Elemental Blasts, Library of Alexandria and Jayemdae Tome, with two Serra Angel and two Moat in the sideboard.
